name: anti-ai-design-style
description: Scans every web or mobile UI file Claude writes and reports how AI-generated it reads, then checks the whole session before it ends. Adds /design-check, /design-fix and /design-brief. Brand distance is measured by the bundled scripts/brand_distance.py; an installed anti-antropik-design is used as an optional cross-check and a disagreement fails the verdict.
